title: Coaching Sequence System
description: A four-image reference-dependent explainer system that locks one coaching-board language across drill setup, progression, correction, and session flow.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the coach-led drill board, diagram grammar, movement cues, and surface hierarchy. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while extending the same visual system to steps, corrections, and complete session flows.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-step-progression-board, 03-common-mistake-correction, 04-session-flow-variant. Queue may run 02-step-progression-board, 03-common-mistake-correction, 04-session-flow-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
